name: Goi ca moi
summary: Gỏi cá mòi is a herring salad at the Thu Bon festival in Duy Thu. The sanctuary essay calls gỏi a dish Cham people liked.
origin: Xã Duy Thu, at lễ hội Thu Bồn.
howToEat: The fish is made into gỏi.
where: Lễ hội Thu Bồn is in xã Duy Thu.
Lễ hội Bà Thu Bồn is a separate date in the same essay, from the 12th of the second lunar month.
seoTitle: Goi ca moi — herring salad at the Thu Bon festival
seoDescription: Gỏi cá mòi is a herring salad at the Thu Bon festival in Duy Thu, a gỏi the sanctuary essay says Cham people liked.
